      "reason_tag": "new feature",

      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents silent address reuse and privacy loss across receive and change branches. The PR addresses issue #35985 where 'multipath expansion silently reuses key material across branches', warning users when single-path keys are unexpectedly duplicated."
